summary: The CorrespondenceCohortSchedule manages correspondence scheduling for cohorts in an educational timetable system. It supports CRUD operations, calculates due dates based on period codes and cohort dates, provides formatted display values, and integrates reminders and alternate languages descriptions. System behavior is controlled via stored procedures and parameters, supporting flexible retrieval and update workflows.
purpose: To facilitate the management, scheduling, retrieval, and notification of correspondence assignments for cohorts within educational program timetables.

workflows.name: Add Correspondence Cohort Schedule
steps: Add parameters: TimetableID, CorrespondenceID, Days, PeriodCodeID, EmailReminderStaffID

workflows.name: Update Correspondence Cohort Schedule
steps: Add parameters: ID, CorrespondenceID, Days, PeriodCodeID, EmailReminderStaffID

workflows.name: Get Schedule by Term, Cohort, Course, Correspondence
steps: Add parameters: TermID, CohortID, CourseID, CorrespondenceID

business_rules: DueDate is calculated based on PeriodCode and Days:
- BEFOREEND: EndDate or EndDateBlock2 minus Days (if EndDateBlock2 exists)
- AFTEREND: EndDate or EndDateBlock2 plus Days (if EndDateBlock2 exists)
PRDueDate is based on earliest start/end date of the PR.
validations: PeriodCode must be one of defined types (BEFORESTART, AFTERSTART, BEFOREEND, AFTEREND)
If sess.UseAltLanguageFields is true, use TypeDescriptionAlt and PeriodDescriptionAlt.
calculations: DueDate based on StartDate, EndDate, EndDateBlock2, PeriodCode, Days
DueDateFormatted and GeneratedDateFormatted as formatted strings
PRDueDate based on earliest start/end date
conditions: If EndDateBlock2 exists, use for BEFOREEND and AFTEREND calculations
If sess.UseAltLanguageFields, alternate descriptions are used
system_behavior: FillList populates CorrespondenceCohortSchedule objects from database
Template_Exists generates a Javascript link for correspondence template
EmailReminderStaffID is used for reminder notifications
dependencies: Database stored procedures: CorrespondenceCohortSchedulesAdd, CorrespondenceCohortSchedulesUpdate, CorrespondenceCohortSchedulesDelete, CorrespondenceCohortSchedulesInherit, CorrespondenceCohortSchedulesSearchCorr, CorrespondenceCohortSchedulesSearchID, CorrespondenceCohortSchedulesSearch, CorrespondenceCohortSchedulesUpdateGenerated, CorrespondenceQueueSearch
exceptions: If SqlDataReader is null, skip list population
If PeriodCode is not recognized, DueDate is NullDate
If EndDateBlock2 is invalid, calculations fallback to EndDate
